title: Denisova Cave yielded a distinct archaic genome
summary: Reich, Green, and colleagues described the Denisova genome in Nature in 2010.
body: David Reich, Richard E. Green, and colleagues, "Genetic history of an archaic hominin group from Denisova Cave in Siberia" (Nature, 2010), reported a genome that was not modern human and not Neanderthal. It is the naming paper for Denisovans as a genetic group. How that group relates to fossils across Asia is still being worked out; this card is the 2010 genetic report, not a finished map.
